component.name: Software Updater
component.summary: Install critical, security and main updates of the operating system

description.p: Software Updater installs critical, security and main updates for the operating system from the configured package sources, using PackageKit or APT; applications from Flathub and the Snap Store are updated in Merkadu, the software center. Updates are grouped like in a classic software updater; each group and package can be unchecked before choosing Install Now.
Software Updater was called SDE Update before Alpha 51; the command is still sde-update.
Update model adapted from Linux Mint's Update Manager (mintupdate) by Clement Lefebvre and the Linux Mint team.
Part of the Selviana Desktop Environment, developed by the Selviana DE Project.
